content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and routed. Summary of what the workers will find:

**Located, substantive review needed**
- **LOL-CAP** — § 14.5 (p0602) mutual consequential/punitive waiver; no aggregate dollar cap surfaced, so cap presence and carve-outs are the open questions.
- **INDEMN** — reciprocal indemnities at 14.1/14.2 with procedure at 14.3; check RevMed's third-party IP coverage and the breadth of our own indemnity.
- **T4C** — 12.2(a)(i) gives us convenience termination (favourable); RevMed's counterpart rights at p0493/p0495 need reading.
- **GOVLAW** — 15.5 plus arbitration at 15.6; both the law and the arbitral seat are redacted, so forum acceptability turns on the full read.
- **ASSIGN** — § 15.2 with our affiliate/successor assignment rights and Acquiror-Family conditions.
- **IP / LICENSE** — Art. X ownership (sole plus joint Program Technology) and the 3.1(a) exclusive grant to us, including post-termination reversion at p0503.
- **AUDIT / LD / INSURANCE / WARRANTY / TRANSITION / NONCOMPETE / EXCLUSIVITY** — all have identified anchors; several run in our favour and are flagged as such to avoid needless redlines.

**Likely absent or inapplicable**
- **MFN** and **NOSOLICIT** — no responsive language on repeated distinct queries.
- **RENEWAL** — term keyed to expiry of payment obligations, no renewal mechanic.
- **MINCOMMIT** — forecasts expressly non-binding; diligence handled under other rules to prevent double-flagging.
